scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking proposals for a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners. The LMS must integrate with existing systems and support approximately 1,500 employees.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
G. RATED CRITERIA
The following sets out the categories, weightings, and descriptions of the rated criteria of the RFP. Proponents who do not meet a minimum threshold score for a category will not proceed to the next stage of the evaluation process.
Product Demonstration:
The evaluation will be conducted in two stages. In Stage 1, all proposals will be evaluated against the rated criteria for a subtotal of 100 points, including a technical component worth 50 points. Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold.
The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City’s discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration.
Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the pricing form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has submitted a proposal for, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (lowest price / proponent's price) x weighting = proponent's score.

insurance_requirements.quote: 2.2.1. Commercial General Liability Insurance in respect to the Services and operations of the Contractor for bodily injury and/or property damage with policy limits. Not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence with a property damage deductible not exceeding Two Thousand Five Hundred ($2,500.00) Dollars. The insurance shall include, to the satisfaction of the City: 2.2.1.1 The City of Medicine Hat as an Additional Insured; 2.2.1.2 Standard non-owned automobile liability; 2.2.1.3 Broad Form Products and Completed Operations Liability; 2.2.1.4 Cross liability; 2.2.1.5 Employer’s liability insurance with limits of liability of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000.00) per employee for each accidental injury to, or death of, an employee of the Consultant or of a sub-consultant, engaged in the Services; Or Contingent Employer’s liability 2.2.2. Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance in respect to the Services with policy limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per claim with a 12-month maintenance period, a deductible of not more than $25,000 and with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000. 2.2.3. Cyber Liability Insurance, where applicable, providing cyber liability insurance, including, without limitation, coverage for cyber-related errors and omissions, media liability, network and information security liability, regulatory fines, penalties with associated forensic investigation expenses, and security breach remediation and notification, for a minimum of $2,000,000 per occurrence for claims for first and third-party costs or damages resulting from any unauthorized access or disclosure, theft, dissemination, and/or use of confidential information or personal information stored or transmitted in any form resulting from any cyber events (including but not limited to network security breaches, privacy events, ransomware attacks) or arising during the performance of the Services. The policy will name the City as an additional named insured, except with errors and omissions. If the policy is written on a claims-made basis, then coverage shall be maintained for a period of two years following the performance of the Services. 2.2.4. Automobile Liability insurance (Owner’s Form) in respect of all vehicles used in the performance of the Contract, with limits of no less than Two Million ($2,000,000.00) Dollars inclusive per occurrence for bodily injury, death, and damage to property.
